title: docs(qa): re-point 27 checklist items in batch E (identity-auth, access-security, api-backend, approvals, ai, attachments-storage, dashboards)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9TTF1z3CcGg2atxzEGqXsh6)_

Fixes #33967
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：平台测试清单 7 个 area 文件里 27 个条目的步骤/夹具/核对文字(批次 E 的 26 个条目，加 #33968 交回的 1 个 SSO 条目),每条 revision +1 并加一行 history。
- 为什么改:18.5.0 发版测试时跑手按原文走不通或读错的地方(锚卡 #33761 账本批次 E),不改的话下一轮跑手会重复踩坑。
- 风险与回滚：只动 docs/qa 下 7 个 JSON 文本，不动产品代码;回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:api-backend.json 的 automation-namespace-address(flow 改为按命名空间一个持有者后整段改写)、identity-auth.json 的 SSO 三条(本地 IdP 何时才需要 OS_TRUSTED_ORIGINS)、dashboards.json 的 cube-query(缺席分支没有现成入口)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:platform-checklist`,预期最后一行 `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 429 items`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Batch E of the v18.5.0 close-out ledger (comment 6896511848 on #33761): the item-text re-point rows for `identity-auth.json`, `access-security.json`, `api-backend.json`, `approvals.json`, `ai.json`, `attachments-storage.json` and `dashboards.json`, 31 rows over 26 items, plus the two out-of-scope lines the runner-kit card #33968 handed back (report 6897030673). Every row was re-read at `origin/main` (the branch starts at `bc6b7ffd`; no area file changed between the ledger's `895783a1` and it except by the carriers #33936, #33929, #33931 and #33981, none of which touches these items) and each edit starts from the residue measured there. Every edited item has `revision` +1 and one `history` row. The area files were edited as text spans by a script and never re-serialised. One clause (acceptance `clause`) changed wording without changing what it requires: `identity-auth.workspace-org-switch` acceptance[3] now says "a role-neutral /meta read"; every other edit is steps, fixtures, verify, negative or automated text.

| Ledger row(s) | Item | Clause edited | What changed |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 2, 184 | api-backend.query-contract-matrix | acceptance[8].verify | States the count: 30 rows, the 22 `op:*` variants (both spellings each) and the 8 `param:*` rows, as `variants` lists them. Rows 2 and 184 are one edit |
| 3 | access-security.rls-both-sides | acceptance[4].verify | QA read `showcase_invoice` adopted too and `showcase_invoice_line` no longer adopted; the verify now says to read the adopted set from the report lines, not from a list. `summary.holes` must still be 0 |
| 19 | api-backend.action-activation-door-contract | automated.ref | The 4-segment 404 is `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` (the pin's assertion, `action-activation-door-live.dogfood.test.ts`), not byte-identical to an unmounted path, which answers `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` (`plugin-hono-server` `adapter.ts`). The test file's own header comment says the same stale thing; it is code and is not edited here |
| 20 | api-backend.client-sdk-namespace-address | fixtures.knownGaps[0] | The bare `/actions` 409 with candidates is reachable live with the family's two-package action fixture (`api-backend.actions-namespace-address`); the gap now says this item's fixture does not stage it and names the one that does |
| 21 | api-backend.actions-namespace-address | fixtures.requires[0] | qa_b's stack is `defineStack(…, { strict: false })`: the strict parse refuses a standalone action whose `objectName` is not in its own stack ("Action 'escalate' references object 'qa_a_ticket' which is not defined in objects.", `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`) |
| 23 | ai.mcp-namespace-faces | fixtures.requires[0], automated.ref | Adds a third scratch package qa_c whose standalone `escalate` on `qa_a_ticket` derives qa_a's face `qa_a_ticket-escalate` (OBJECT-ACTION, `face-name.ts` `deriveAiFaceName`), so negative[2] is drivable live; a namespace named after the object is refused at install (ADR-0150 D6) |
| 24 | access-security.permission-set-address-in-execution-context | fixtures.requires[2] | The qa_a_ticket record is owned by M (`owner_id`); on a private scratch object an admin-owned row reads 0 rows for M |
| 25 | access-security.record-view-read-audit | steps[0] | The audit read uses the JSON filter form `$filter={"action":"read"}` (or the AST); OData text answers 400 `INVALID_FILTER` (the normalizer parses `$filter` as JSON, `protocol-data-crud.ts`) |
| 27 | attachments-storage.orphan-tombstone-reap | steps[1] | A restart sweeps at the first tick only when `sys_lifecycle_state` row `lifecycle` `last_swept_at` is older than one interval (1 h) (`lifecycle-service.ts` `runFirstScheduledSweep`, #29918); the step ages it before each restart |
| 28 | attachments-storage.upload-session-abort | steps[3] | The sweep leg names the same watermark rule |
| 29 | dashboards.analytics-exposure-gate-and-measure-aggregate | steps[1] | The filter key is `where`; `filters` is refused 400 naming `where` |
| 30 | identity-auth.idp-group-permission-set-mapping | fixtures.requires[1] | Leave `OS_SSO_DOMAIN_VERIFICATION` unset (opt-in, ADR-0135 D6); with it true SSO sign-in is refused "Provider domain has not been verified" |
| 32 | identity-auth.auth-gate-held-session-raw-host-families | fixtures.requires[1] | Warns that saving `mfa_required=everyone` with grace 0 also holds the admin who saved it |
| 45 | api-backend.route-ledger-live-parity | title, fixtures.requires[1], steps[3] | SEVENTEEN ledgers, not sixteen: `packages/services/service-storage/src/attachment-removal-route-ledger.ts` (one row, `DELETE /api/v1/attachments/:id`). steps[3] samples it with an unknown id, which the own-row door answers 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` (`own-row-delete-routes.ts`), never with a real id |
| 46 | access-security.share-link-capability-tokens | steps[6] | The record-gone leg deletes the brief as the admin; the minter persona gets 403 |
| 58, 193 | api-backend.automation-namespace-address | fixtures.knownGaps[0], negative[3] | Since #31696 flow (and connector) is one holder per namespace (`NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES`, read at the base), so a second namespace's holder installs; each namespaced address serves its own holder, and only the bare path, `_env` and a third namespace answer 409 naming both (QA run #33910). The disabled-holder cases still rest on the runtime unit pins, named. Rows 58 and 193 are one edit |
| 66 | dashboards.cube-query | steps[0] | `analytics` is on `PLATFORM_ALWAYS_ON_CAPABILITIES`, mounted on every served boot unless `--preset minimal` (`capability-composition.ts` `resolveServedCapabilities`), so the absent-slot arm has no stock door; a run without a minimal-preset boot records it skipped with that reason. Whether the showcase boots under `--preset minimal` was not measured |
| 67 | access-security.security-catalog-one-holder-and-boot-report | acceptance[1].verify, fixtures.requires[1] | A permission set holds one name per namespace (`security-catalog-namespace.ts`, ADR-0150 D2/D9), so the conflicting manifest declares no namespace or the holder's; with its own namespace the 422 names only the position |
| 68 | approvals.record-page-decisions | steps[9] | Click the name text in the New approver option row (the row also carries a mailto link and a copy button) |
| 69 | approvals.request-page-reply-and-reader-visibility | acceptance[2].verify | The external member for the 403 leg is mintable on a stock boot: `invite-member` with role `external`, sign-up with `invitationId`, `accept-invitation` (both routes in `auth-route-ledger.ts`), replacing "record that leg not exercised" |
| 71 | dashboards.global-filters-rescope | fixtures.requires[2] | The scratch package body is `{id, name, version: '0.1.0', type: 'app'}` (`label` is refused by the strict manifest); a scratch dashboard gives its account widgets a `filterBindings` before the first save, else 422 `dashboard-filter-field-unknown` |
| 92, 94 | identity-auth.auth-method-matrix | fixtures.requires[0], steps[3] | The generic OIDC variant has no env switch: read it on `identity-auth.linked-accounts-social`'s scratch-copy OIDC boot (row 92). The PROD leg is `objectstack serve` with `OS_DATABASE_URL`, `OS_AUTH_SECRET` and `OS_SECRET_KEY` (row 94) |
| 95, 96 | identity-auth.console-two-factor-prompt-phone-doors | acceptance[3].verify, fixtures.requires[2] | The rendered wrong-password text has no period; the period-ended literal is `ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts`'s no-token fallback (row 95). Read the code from the log line's `body:` field; a six-digit grep catches the `dev-sms-EPOCHMS-N` messageId digits (`sms-service.ts`) (row 96) |
| 97, 98 | identity-auth.linked-accounts-social | fixtures.requires[1], steps[5] | The IdP test identity carries the caller's email (else `error=email_does_not_match`) (row 97). The data door serves no aggregate route at the base (no `/aggregate` route in the REST or runtime source): GET answers 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, POST 405; the stale "bare aggregate 400" is dropped (row 98) |
| 104 | identity-auth.sso-enforced-first-paint | fixtures.requires[1] | Not a bespoke-env item: a stock showcase with `OS_SSO_ENABLED`, `OS_AUTH_SSO_ONLY` and a runtime-registered provider satisfies it |
| 105 | identity-auth.workspace-org-switch | acceptance[3].clause, acceptance[3].verify | Names a role-neutral `/meta` read (`/meta/object/showcase_task`); `/meta/app` filters apps by the caller's per-org grade. The clause still requires deployment-level metadata |
| found while doing #33967, source #33968 report 6897030673 (line 1) | identity-auth.sso-provider-groups-claim, plus the same wording in identity-auth.idp-group-permission-set-mapping fixtures.requires[1] and identity-auth.auth-method-matrix fixtures.requires[2] | fixtures.requires[0] | A dev boot (`os dev`) already trusts `http://localhost:*` (`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` adds it when the boot is a dev boot; `@better-auth/sso`'s `validateOIDCEndpointUrl` skips a trusted origin), so `OS_TRUSTED_ORIGINS` is needed only on a production boot or another private origin. PR #33997 (`qa-fixture.mjs oidc-stub`) is not merged at the base, so no item cites the script |
| found while doing #33967, source #33968 report 6897030673 (line 2) | api-backend.actions-namespace-address, api-backend.automation-namespace-address | negative[2]; fixtures.knownGaps[0] | Where the item removes an installed package (actions negative[2]) or names why one cannot be removed (automation knownGaps[0]), it names `DELETE /api/v1/marketplace/install-local/MANIFEST_ID`; `DELETE /api/v1/packages/ID` answers 422 `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`. `api-backend.client-sdk-namespace-address` has no removal step, so nothing is added there |

No row was already right at the base, and none moved to another carrier.

Forced test changes: none.

## Tests

No code changed. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` and the gate families `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this diff were run on the final head; the commands, exit codes and the `--ran` reconciliation are in the os-dev-report comment on #33967.

## Acceptance notes

- Structural proof: the span editor asserted, per area file, that the new document equals the old one plus the declared operations (value-equal), that every other item is value-equal, and that the text outside the edited items is byte-identical.
- Not on this card's rows, noted only: `access-security.permission-set-address-in-execution-context` fixtures.knownGaps[0] still says two packages each shipping `qa_a_reader` is not reachable through install, but a permission set has been one name per namespace since ADR-0150 D2/D9 (`security-catalog-namespace.ts`), so two namespaces can now each hold it; and the header comment of `packages/qa/dogfood/test/action-activation-door-live.dogfood.test.ts` (line 19) still says "byte-identical to an unmounted path" while its own assertion reads `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`.
- QA readings the edits rest on and that were not re-driven live here: rows 3, 32, 46, 68, 69, 92, 94, 95, 97, 104 and 105 (each names its QA run); the source half of each was re-read at the base.

## Verification

- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` → `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 429 items (421 active, 3 planned)`.
